description: Explicit observed-data airlock ledger for Gate 470. PDG-style quark mass rows and Cabibbo target are admitted as bridge-only metadata. ASHA-specific rank-complete comparators I_spec/I_K and branch tags are intentionally null unless supplied by an external bridge ledger; PDG mass tables alone do not publish I_K.
